title: Three-Element Better-Quasi-Order
exact_target: Can the better-quasi-order property of only three incomparable elements be proved with strictly less than arithmetical transfinite recursion?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7500125 (AMR-074-0125). CC BY 4.0.

Anton Freund, On the Logical Strength of the Better Quasi Order with Three Elements, arXiv:2206.11132v2 (10 August 2022), Introduction, pp. 1--2.
